question: Related Questions Q. Am I eligable to take zakat money? 17516 views Q. Some amount in Cash in name of my daughter who is Balig now. Need to understand the ruling on the amount. 1721 views Q. Zakat 1535 views Q. I have bought a land in the year 2001 for investment purpose. My intention was to sell it and utilize its money for the purpose of building our house whenever we plan to have one since we don?t have our own house yet and are still renting it from outside. Later on, I bought a land and am now building my house on it without selling out the previous land. Now, I have changed my plan to sell that plot and have decided to keep it until, either I decide to sell it or do some sort of business on it. I want to know, (1) Do I have to pay zakat on this land that I bought with the intention to sell and have not sold yet. (2) If so, since when? (3) At what rate per square unit? Kindly advise. 1951 views Q. Can a servant of Syed be given zakat ? 3541 views Q. Bismi-Allah-ArRahmaan-ArRaheem Kind Attention: Mufti in-charge : Fatwa Department : Darul Ifta Deoband, India Subject: Fatwa requisition regarding utilization of collected Zakah funds for public services Respected Sir, Assalamualaikum, Pleased to introduce myself as Mufti Myint Thein @ Mufti Abdussalaam, a Myanmar Muslim born and brought up in Yangon, Myanmar and together with other enthusiastic Muslims, has been actively and voluntarily conducting Islamic Religious activities such as proving free education on Quran and Hadiths as well as other Islamic educational knowledge and public services that would benefit towards Muslims living in Union of Myanmar as a minority community. Without taking much precious time of your esteemed self, kindly allow us to bring the subject and purpose of this mail. We would like to seek some religious verdicts (Fatwas) on some forms of utilizing collected Zakah funds. (that have been collected as a purpose of implementing Baitul Maal system within the community). Therefore, would like to request your esteemed self very humbly to kindly issue Fatwas upon implementing following listed ways of Zakah funds utilization. Kindly enlighten us and issue Fataawa: 1. whether it is permissible in Islam to utilize the collected zakah funds for public services such as building hospitals, clinics, schools, purchasing vehicles for funeral services, information services etc... 2. whether it is permissible to implement ?Micro Loan? system. 3. As we are living in a country where Muslims are minority, is it permissible to utilize the collected zakah funds for public services intended for both muslims and non-muslims such as relief services for earthquake victims, storm victims (?Nargis? victims), Tsunami victims etc? so that we muslims in the region could be understood by non-muslims much of whom have many misconceptions and negative thoughts towards Islam and Muslims. I am having Mutual Funds of about 150000. I am paying loan of 200000 every year. I dont have any cash in my hand. Do I need to pay zakat for Mutual Funds? 3460 views Q. Can you please advise if there is an islamic establishmnet, say a madrassa where poor students are boarded and from where they get their islamic and worldly education. And since the students are poor and recipients of zakaat, the organization that runs this madrassa collects zakaat from the general public to meet the general expenses of these poor students. What are the rules on consuming this zakaat money by 1) the admininstrators and teachers of this madrassa, for their salary? 2) eating food by these teachers and staff from the same zakaat money collected for the food expenses of these poor students 3) can the same zakaat money be used to cook food for the general public if say there is a public lecture at this madrassa or at a near by mosque? 2246 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 59387 Country: India Title: Use of Interest and Zakah money Question: I have uncle who is having too much debt from personal finance company and he is paying every month more and more interest money. He is having three children all are earning good but none of them is helping and also my uncle is not discussing this issue with his son. My uncle is also not doing anything his situation is now he can take zakah money also. So that can I use my zakah and interest money both or either of one for that purpose. Is he eligible for taking this money? Answer ID: 59387 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 993/998/L=08/1436) If he is really eligible to receive zakah then you may give him both the zakah as well as interest money. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
